lede: The biggest thing on the public calendar this week is Thursday's Planning and Zoning Commission meeting, where three Town-owned development projects — including the Carhenge Redevelopment at 700 W Pacific — are up for subdivision and concept review, all in the Accommodations 2 zone. The same day, SMART's board votes on two vendor contracts tied to the gondola structural analysis, which is as close to a bridge-or-bust decision as it gets. Council also convenes Monday for a public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive liquor permit.
